NOTIFICATION
With reference to Commission's advertisement NO. PSC-R(B)/L4/202O Dated 8th
Dec 2020 , it is to inform all the eligible candidates that Commission has fixed the date for
conducting of written examination for the post of Foreman, Group 'B' (Non Gazetted), under the
Department of Printing, on 10th and 11th March, 2022aIAPPSC Examination Hall, ltanagar.
Further, the candidates are hereby directed to download their admit card w.e.f
l't March '2022 from Commission's Website www.appsc.gov.in
